podcast.body: This song title refers to the geometric concept of a plain surface covered by the repeated use of a single shape without gaps or overlapping, exemplifying Alt-J's properly geeky subject matter in their lyrics. "A plain surface covered by repeated use of a single shape without gaps or overlapping. That's a Tessellate, by the way, which is also a name of one of their songs."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
